Actual complete ternary comparison-state enumeration confirms every polynomial coefficient at n=3..6, beyond the symbolic transfer recurrence. Infinite statements depend on the written proof, not those finite tests. originality.rationale: The primary 2013 standard-example paper concerns order dimension, not type spectra. The fully read public cyclic-incidence theorem applies only when n>=2r+1, whereas the new family has cyclic width r=n-2; its asserted domain includes the n=3 case but excludes all n>=4. Its short-arc mixed-type formula is not valid in general in the excluded regime: the first discrepancy is at n=6 (192 extrapolated versus 195 actual). The separate three-incidence result is a different fixed-width asymptotic. The classical cycle independence transfer law and hard-core Gaussian techniques are credited as known ingredients. A full bivariate singleton polynomial, one-sided corrections and joint type law for the excluded growing-width regime were not identified; historical-priority risk remains.

value.rationale: The two-omission cyclic deformation of high-dimensional standard examples is a natural parameter family, not an arbitrary finite subset. An exact complete *bivariate* one-type polynomial resolves predecessor and successor counts rank by rank for every n>=3; its highly nontrivial one-sided corrections make the transfer trace alone insufficient. The rigorously proved seven-pair first two-sided majority, sharp exponential one-sided rarity and the negative 2/3 Gaussian correlation quantify logical extension freedom and provide a natural comparison with the opposite sparse-incidence regime. No general downstream theorem is claimed, but this natural exact invariant and all-order distribution are reproducible, not known-table recomputations in the checked sources.
